nodes.description: uint256 public seed, set to block.timestamp at construction, drives all pseudo-random trait generation and age growth
bool public saleIsActive gating the claim/mint function
uint public next_token, monotonically increasing token id counter used by claim
mapping(uint=>uint) public xp storing experience points per token
mapping(uint=>uint) public level storing character level per token
mapping(address=>uint) public wards, authorization whitelist consumed by the auth modifier
uint256 private age = 31, base age range bound used by pluck for trait generation
uint256 private lucky = 101, base luck range bound used by pluck
ERC721 mapping(address=>uint256) _balances, mutated by _mint/_transfer/_burn
ERC721 mapping(uint256=>address) _owners, token ownership registry written by _mint/_transfer/_burn
Role constructor: sets seed = block.timestamp and grants wards[msg.sender] = 1
public nonReentrant claim(): requires saleIsActive, sets level[next_token]=1, _safeMint to msg.sender, increments next_token
public onlyOwner toggle of saleIsActive
external levelUp(uint): checks _isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender), burns xp, increments level and emits leveled
external auth addXp(uint,uint): adds xp to a token after checking token existence
external auth addListXp(uint[],uint[]): batch adds xp to many tokens in a loop
public pure xp_required(uint): arithmetic loop computing cumulative xp threshold (level*1000 + sum(i*1000))
external auth rely(address): grants authorization by writing wards[guy]=1
external auth deny(address): revokes authorization by writing wards[guy]=0
public view getAge(uint): derives age from (block.timestamp - seed)/31536000 plus plucked base age
internal view pluck(uint,string,string[]/uint): deterministic selection based on seed+key+tokenId hashing
internal pure random(string): keccak256 of the encoded input producing the pseudo-random seed value
internal pure toString(uint): decimal string conversion used for hashing keys and SVG/JSON output
public view tokenURI(uint): assembles the on-chain SVG and base64 JSON metadata
internal _safeMint(address,uint): mints token then performs the ERC721 receiver callback check
private _checkOnERC721Received: external try/catch call to onERC721Received on the recipient contract
msg.sender, attacker-controlled caller used for authorization checks and as mint recipient
block.timestamp, miner-influenced value used as seed at construction and as the age clock
External IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received call performed during minting, control transferred to an attacker-controlled contract
xp and level state arithmetic (xp[_tokenId] += _xp, xp[_tokenId] -= _xp_required, level+1) performed on token accounting
_tokenId parameter of levelUp
_next_role local in claim copying next_token before minting
_level local in levelUp holding level[_tokenId]
_xp_required local in levelUp holding the computed threshold
_tokenId parameter of addXp
_xp parameter of addXp
loop index i in addListXp
curent_level parameter of xp_required
growthAge local in getAge derived from block.timestamp - seed
guy parameter of rely/deny authorization functions
rand local in pluck holding the pseudo-random value
tokenId parameter of tokenURI
value parameter of toString

rely's auth modifier requires wards[msg.sender]==1
deny's auth modifier requires wards[msg.sender]==1
constructor grants wards[msg.sender]=1, the deployer privilege
constructor sets seed = block.timestamp, a miner-influenced deployment value
getAge computes growthAge from (block.timestamp - seed) => timestamp dependency
rely reads the wards authorization mapping
deny reads the wards authorization mapping
rely writes wards[guy]=1 granting power
deny writes wards[guy]=0 revoking power
claim requires saleIsActive to be true
flipSaleState toggles saleIsActive
claim increments next_token after minting
local _next_role copies next_token before the increment
claim initializes level[_next_role]=1
_next_role is a claim-local derived from next_token
claim writes level[_next_role] for the new token
claim calls _safeMint, which performs the ERC721 receiver check
levelUp parameter _tokenId selects the token being leveled
levelUp reads xp[_tokenId] for the requirement check
levelUp reads level[_tokenId]
levelUp writes level[_tokenId] = _level + 1
levelUp decrements xp[_tokenId] -= _xp_required
levelUp calls xp_required(_level) to compute the threshold
local _level holds level[_tokenId] inside levelUp
local _xp_required holds the computed xp threshold
levelUp performs the xp/level arithmetic state mutation
addXp parameter _tokenId
addXp parameter _xp
addXp writes xp[_tokenId] += _xp
addXp performs checked xp addition on token accounting
addListXp batch writes xp[_tokenIds[i]] += _xps[i]
addListXp performs looped xp addition on token accounting
loop index i drives the addListXp batch iteration
xp_required parameter curent_level drives the threshold arithmetic
getAge uses seed as the life-clock base, making age depend on deployment/block timestamp
getAge calls pluck for the base age value
local growthAge is derived from the timestamp delta
pluck feeds seed into random(...) making traits deterministic per seed
pluck calls random with the composed hash key
local rand holds the pseudo-random value used for modular selection
seed is part of the string hashed by random
pluck calls toString(tokenId) to build the hash key
tokenURI calls getAge to render the age text
tokenURI renders traits obtained indirectly through pluck getters
tokenURI parameter tokenId controls the rendered metadata
tokenURI calls toString(tokenId) for the JSON name

_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received after writing balances/owners
_checkOnERC721Received invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract, transferring control
a malicious recipient can reenter claim during _safeMint (mitigated only by nonReentrant)
the recipient callback can reenter the unguarded levelUp while mint state is mid-update
the recipient callback can recursively trigger _safeMint
_mint/_safeMint increases _balances[to] by 1
_mint/_safeMint writes _owners[tokenId] = to
constructor initializes seed used by all randomness
constructor sets wards[msg.sender]=1 as the initial privileged account

normalization_plan.reason: _tokenId is an input parameter fully consumed by levelUp's authorization and accounting logic
_next_role is a transient copy of next_token used only inside claim
_level is a transient read of level[_tokenId] inside levelUp
_xp_required is the arithmetic threshold whose computation and subtraction constitute the xp accounting operation
_tokenId is an input parameter fully consumed by addXp's existence check and xp write
_xp is an input parameter fully consumed by addXp's xp write
loop index i exists only to drive the addListXp batch iteration
curent_level is the sole input parameter of the xp_required arithmetic routine
growthAge is a transient timestamp-delta computation local to getAge
guy is the authorization target parameter written into the wards mapping by rely/deny
rand is a transient pseudo-random value local to pluck's selection logic
tokenId is an input parameter fully consumed by tokenURI's metadata rendering
value is the sole input parameter of the toString conversion routine
